install.title: Install a plugin
install.hint: Paste the link of a plugin folder on GitHub or GitLab, or an absolute local path. Only packages signed by a trusted publisher install.
install.privateRepo: Private repository? Add an access token
install.downgrade: This version is older than the installed {{installed}}. Uninstall first to go back.

keys.title: Trusted publishers
keys.hint: Plugins signed with one of these keys can be installed. Add only keys you got from the publisher directly.
keys.removeBody: New installs and updates signed with this key will be refused. Plugins already installed keep working.

devMode.title: Developer mode
devMode.hint: Lets you install unsigned plugins from a local folder. It lasts for one session: the next normal launch is back in the safe mode.
devMode.confirmBody: PatchMan will ask for Touch ID and restart. Until the next restart you can install unsigned plugins from a folder; only use plugins you trust.
devMode.bannerBody: unsigned plugins can be installed in this session.
